responsibility: Defines the primary target macros, constants, ABI-visible layout rules, assembler/linker specs, and exported configuration interfaces for the RISC-V port. It establishes word and register sizes, calling-convention constants, section and assembly output helpers, driver self-specs, exception/unwind register mappings, vector-size macros, and declarations of target support variables and helper entry points, serving as the central compile-time configuration header paired with the procedural logic in riscv.cc.
same_name_distinction: Within the `riscv` group, this header is the compile-time configuration interface for the port, defining target macros, ABI/layout constants, assembler specs, driver specs, and exported declarations. Unlike `riscv.cc`, it does not implement target hooks; unlike `riscv.md`, it is not an RTL machine description; and unlike `riscv.opt`, it does not define command-line option tables.
